Runner opens the Langfuse span and builds HarnessDeps(predictor).
Sees the system prompt and 8 tool schemas, then picks a tool or answers.

Every tool returns a Pydantic model from schemas.py
Each result has a source field (model or CSV path) so answers are
Numbers are rounded to 4 dp at the tool boundary
Numbers only from tool results; fix invalid inputs using the tool error;
probabilities are never certainties; call out false premises; 2026 predictions
Tool-side ModelRetry lists the valid values (driver codes, 1-22, rounds 1-15).

retry, then the answer ships with unverified numbers listed.

ChatResult.nudge is true when anything unverified, errored, retried, capped or
timed out, so the UI asks for a thumbs rating.
